melissa: Quick heads-up — we have a regulated SaaS prospect asking for a private deployment (VPC + on-prem connector), FIPS KMS, and a hard SLO: P50 <= 120ms for short completions (<=256 tokens). They want a staged rollout targeted by 2026-04-15. Can owners confirm feasibility + blockers by EOD tomorrow? Needed: runtime quant/profile, infra peering & capacity, security audit checklist, rollout gating + observability.

rajesh: thanks. timeline seems tight. couple clarifying q's: 1) do they require a specific model family or are smaller quantized variants acceptable? 2) expected qps range for initial ramp?

melissa: they prefer our medium LLM (approx 4B params) but will accept a quantized 4B or a 2B if perf is materially better on latency/cost. initial qps estimate: 10-20 rps, ramp to ~100 rps over 6 weeks.

anna (runtime): For P50 120ms on 4B we need an aggressive quant profile + KV cache warmup. Two risks: prefix length variability and attention kernel choice on target hosts. I can draft a quant/profile plan and a fallback variant (2B) — need 7 working days to validate on dedicated infra.

derek (infra): Network-wise VPC peering + private ingress is fine but we need reserved GPU capacity for dedicated pool. To hit 100 rps for 4B with low latency, estimate: 6x A100-style GPUs reserved (can optimize with batching). Procurement/ICR lead time ~3 weeks for reserved pool in the requested region unless we reallocate burst capacity. Also need a NAT/proxy pattern for private control-plane traffic.

sam (security): Compliance checklist: FIPS KMS + HSM integration, tenant isolation review, audit log retention (90d+), config hardening, and a scoped pen-test. FIPS KMS integration + validation will take ~2 weeks; pen-test scheduling depends on vendor windows. I also need to confirm whether customer requires data-e2e-separation (separate VPC subnets).

tara (sre): I'll own rollout runbook/canary gating. Propose staged canaries: internal smoke -> partner beta (5% traffic) -> 25% -> 100% over 6 weeks with automated rollback on latency or error budget burn. Need trace-level dashboards and alerting for trace p50/p95, error-rate, and kv-cache hit-rate. ETA to produce runbook: 3 business days.

rajesh: action items: anna will produce quant validation plan (owner: anna, due: +7d). derek to confirm reserved pool sizing + network design (owner: derek, due: +3d). sam to publish security checklist and gating criteria (owner: sam, due: +5d). tara to draft runbook and alerts (owner: tara, due: +3d). I'll coordinate model fallback path and integration tests (owner: rajesh, due: +10d).

melissa: great — please add your items to the cross-team ticket #PRJ-1428 and drop links here when done. I'll sync with sales for contract dates. If any team cannot meet deadlines call it out now so we can negotiate scope (e.g., start with 2B variant + faster rollout).

anna (runtime): added test matrix to PRJ-1428 and included perf baseline for 2B vs 4B quant. Link: https://redwood.internal/prj/1428/perf. Note: quantizing 4B to 4-bit gives cost gains but increases tail variance; recommend start with 2B for initial GA and enable 4B canary after 2-week soak.

derek (infra): created infra subtask in PRJ-1428 with network diagram and capacity request. Link: https://redwood.internal/prj/1428/infra. I can provision a minimal reserved pool if budget approved — pinging finance.

sam (security): checklist posted to PRJ-1428/security. Two hard blockers flagged: FIPS KMS validation and pen-test completion. Both must be green before 100% traffic.

tara (sre): runbook draft posted: https://redwood.internal/prj/1428/runbook. Added canary thresholds: p50 > 120ms or p95 > 300ms -> auto-rollback, plus error-rate > 1% for 5m.

melissa: thanks everyone. Next steps: owners keep those deadlines, I'll schedule a 30m cross-team sync for Wednesday 2026-03-31 10:30 PT. If anyone needs to move their date, reply here. Otherwise I'll mark this for the roadmap and propose starting with 2B GA + 4B canary.

ci-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Regulated SaaS Onramp — cross-team sync" on 2026-03-31 10:30 PT. Attendees: melissa, rajesh, anna, derek, sam, tara.

melissa: noted — thanks ci-bot. If no blockers posted by EOD tomorrow I'll send the meeting agenda and preliminary PRD. :thumbsup:
